reuse.reason: The pinned official workspace plugin assumes an authorized Host and offers no account-availability contract in its service, shortcuts or internally registered browser/picker. This complete browser fork retains official UI and Host semantics while isolating account-bound data and actions. Anonymous search, view options, add workspace and picker interactions request the account login dialog before opening private workflows; checking/error states remain disabled. Service calls, restoration, stale snapshots and asynchronous results remain fail-closed, and signed-in actions still require real RemoteAccess.
gaps: Anonymous workspace navigation controls remain clickable and request sign-in before account-bound work. Checking/error states remain disabled. Private workspace/session rows stay hidden until the checked account is authenticated; no private read is made for the public empty state.
Anonymous workspace lists remain empty without a sign-in prompt; the heading and account-gated actions stay visible.
